title: Elef work manifest (elef.json)
description: Identity file at a work folder root. Grounded in read_manifest (crates/local-store/src/manifest.rs): only id and schema_version are read; unknown fields are ignored so newer writers stay openable. Enforced by tooling/check_spec.py via bin/check quick.

id.description: Work identity (UUID). Serialized hyphenated lowercase by write_manifest_atomic; readers accept any form Uuid::parse_str accepts.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version. Current value is MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION (crates/local-store/src/consts.rs). Higher values are read for known fields with a non-blocking notice (manifest_notices in manifest.rs).
